summary: The comment argues that the FCC should strengthen hearings and CIPA enforcement to ensure a thorough review of the scientific evidence and legal precedents related to CIPA enforcement. The FCC is urged to conduct an independent, industry-neutral scientific assessment of RF exposure risks and implement transparent, evidence-based policies to protect public health. The comment calls for the FCC to consider ecological and health impacts of RF radiation before proceeding with rulemaking on cell towers and wireless infrastructure. It cites external evidence that new cell tower transmitters would increase involuntary exposure to RF radiation, which poses public health risks to humans and wildlife.
filer_raw: Theodora Scarato | Director of Wireless and EMF Program at Environmental Health Sciences
